identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][tls] Add stable rcgen local TLS bootstrap

review_prompts: Does configuration fail closed unless TLS mode is explicitly managed_external or local_self_signed?
Can local bootstrap ever mutate externally managed certificate/key paths?
Does ordinary restart reuse the same certificate identity without regeneration?
Is replacement explicit and atomic with last-valid preservation on failure?
Do tests prove SANs, server-auth, rustls acceptance, restrictive permissions, and concurrent exclusion?
residual_risk: Native Windows execution remains a pre-merge integration residual because nessus.local did not resolve during pre-PR validation; the protected current-user-only DACL behavior is implemented and covered by a native-Windows-gated Rust test.
